_note: Monthly targets shown in the Money app's Everyday tab, in your home currency. None are set until you tell the money bot a number ("set my day-to-day budget to 2500"). Keys: day_to_day (every category outside the committed, chosen and one-off groups in finance/bot/app_sync.py CATEGORY_GROUPS), day_to_day_ex_travel (the same without travel), food (dining + hawker + groceries), shopping, travel, fun (entertainment + activities). Example: {"day_to_day": 2500, "food": 700}.
